changeSet.author: Gregory Bliault
changeSet.sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF to_regclass('specimen') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE specimen ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sanitary_alert varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fk_transfer_status bigint, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fk_selective_conservation bigint, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS selective_conservation_comment varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS particular_interest varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS study_potential boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS study_potential_comment varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sampling_purpose varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS preservation_condition varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS validity_date timestamp with time zone, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS storage_location varchar(1000); END IF; IF to_regclass('specimen_aud') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE specimen_aud ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sanitary_alert varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sanitary_alert_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fk_transfer_status bigint, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fk_transfer_status_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fk_selective_conservation bigint, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fk_selective_conservation_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS selective_conservation_comment varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS selective_conservation_comment_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS particular_interest varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS particular_interest_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS study_potential boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS study_potential_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS study_potential_comment varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS study_potential_comment_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sampling_purpose varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sampling_purpose_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS preservation_condition varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS preservation_condition_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS validity_date timestamp with time zone, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS validity_date_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS storage_location varchar(1000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS storage_location_mod boolean; END IF; END $$; DO $$ BEGIN IF to_regclass('siamois_document') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE siamois_document ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS storage_location varchar(1000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS mold_comment varchar(5000); END IF; IF to_regclass('siamois_document_aud') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE siamois_document_aud ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS storage_location varchar(1000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS storage_location_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS mold_comment varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS mold_comment_mod boolean; END IF; END $$; DO $$ BEGIN IF to_regclass('action_unit') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE action_unit ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS region_maritime_facade varchar(255), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fk_georeferencing_document bigint; END IF; IF to_regclass('action_unit_aud') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE action_unit_aud ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS region_maritime_facade varchar(255), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS region_maritime_facade_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fk_georeferencing_document bigint, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS fk_georeferencing_document_mod boolean; END IF; END $$; DO $$ BEGIN IF to_regclass('spatial_unit') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE spatial_unit ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS insee_code varchar(255), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS locality_name varchar(255), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS comments varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shom_map_number varchar(255); END IF; IF to_regclass('spatial_unit_aud') IS NOT NULL THEN ALTER TABLE spatial_unit_aud ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS insee_code varchar(255), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS insee_code_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS locality_name varchar(255), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS locality_name_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS comments varchar(5000), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS comments_mod boolean, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shom_map_number varchar(255), ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shom_map_number_mod boolean; END IF; END $$;
